coverage_override.reason: The hand summon procedure, resulting summon lock, and detached-material Level-changing trigger with HOPT are three audit units.

effects.printed_clause: If you control no monsters, or control a Dragon Xyz Monster, you can Special Summon this card from your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: An uncopyable hand EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC checks the printed field condition and an open Monster Zone.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses a condition-checked, non-activated hand Special Summon procedure.

effects.printed_clause: If Special Summoned this way, you cannot Special Summon EARTH monsters for the rest of this turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The summon procedure registers a player-targeted EARTH Special Summon restriction through the End Phase.

official_references.matched_structure: Registers a procedure-result player restriction with a phase reset.

effects.printed_clause: If detached from a Stellaer Xyz to activate its effect: target 2 cards you control, declare Level 8-10; they become that Level until end of turn. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: The detach timing is corrected with GLOBALFLAG_DETACH_EVENT and EVENT_DETACH_MATERIAL. The targeting code still requires two face-up monsters with positive Levels, announces 8-10, and applies temporary EFFECT_CHANGE_LEVEL.

official_references.matched_structure: Enables and responds to EVENT_DETACH_MATERIAL regardless of the detached card's destination.
Applies a declared temporary Level using EFFECT_CHANGE_LEVEL.

effects.issue: The detach destination defect is fixed, but the print says target 2 cards while the only coherent Level-changing implementation targets face-up monsters with Levels. The card text needs a ruling/correction (likely '2 face-up monsters you control') before this literal mismatch can be resolved safely.
